title: Synthesis and electrical properties of 2D cubic vanadium nitride
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23994-24001
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03161C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qiuyun Yang, Ziping Wang, Fanfan Shi, Dehu Li, Yao Peng, Jianyi Liu
2D cubic-phase vanadium nitride films were synthesized via atomic substitution. Electrical transport tests indicated that sheet resistance decreased with thickness and was temperature-independent. Transfer curves verified metallic behavior.
